title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 19.2 up to but not including 19.4.11, 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.9, and 19.6 up to but not including 19.6.2 allowed authenticated users with fine-grained personal access tokens to read and apply merge request suggestions from projects outside their token's authorized scope due to incorrect authorization checks. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
